LOOK: Militant women’s group Gabriela stages a protest at the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) main office in Intramuros, Manila, on Wednesday, September 3, urging the poll body to immediately proclaim Gabriela Women’s Party (GWP) as a winner in Congress. 

The group stresses that with the COMELEC en banc’s affirmation of Duterte Youth’s disqualification, no legal obstacle remains, making it necessary for Gabriela, as the next eligible party-list, to be officially proclaimed.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB

[6:30AM]  #Ikorodu
#Ogolonto
#TrafficUpdate

It is a rapid movement  from Aruna inwards Agric but slightly slow approaching Aunty Kenny.
 There's faster movement inward Idiroko, Ogolonto, Majidun all the way to Itowolo. 

The return journey on that stretch back to Aruna has nothing to worry about. 

Igbogbo and its environs are calm. Moving inward Ebute Road to connect Ibeshe roundabout, Mobil down to Police post is good. 
Navigating through Oba Sekunmade down to Ogolonto is in good shape.
Ita elewa axis is good to go on all sides.
Drive cautiously!

[6:18AM] #Ojota
#IkoroduRd
 #TrafficUpdate

Motor ways inward Ojota likewise movement from Ketu under the Tsunami interchange inward Ojota is still looking good traffic wise.
There's a faulty LAWMA Truck with a tyre problem on the service lane by Fidelity bank inward New garage but not affectingtraffic flow for now.

Odoyalaro up to Maryland is looking good down to Idiroko and Anthony.

Anthony Obanikoro, Palmgrove down to Onipan,  Fadeyi and  Dorman 
long bridge is good also.

The return journey from the foot of Dorman Long bridge to Fadeyi all the way to New Garage is very free.

Meanwhile the men of the Ministry of works are working on the expansion joint at Odoyalaro inward Ojota but not affecting movement at the moment.
New garage inward Ojota enroute ketu interchange looks good.
